description: This file defines the API for managing associated MoCA devices within the Device.MoCA.Interface.{i}.AssociatedDevice object, including the class MoCAInterfaceAssociatedDevice with methods to retrieve various device parameters such as MAC address, Node ID, version, rates, power levels, and status indicators.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceAssociatedDevice
classes.description: Class providing access to properties and status of associated MoCA devices, including methods to get MAC address, Node ID, highest supported version, rates, power levels, and activity status.

methods.name: get_MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the associated MoCA device.

methods.name: get_NodeID
methods.description: Retrieves the Node ID of the remote MoCA device.

methods.name: get_PreferredNC
methods.description: Checks if the remote device is a preferred Network Coordinator.

methods.name: get_HighestVersion
methods.description: Gets the highest MoCA version supported by the remote device.

methods.name: get_PHYTxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the PHY transmit rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_PHYRxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the PHY receive rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_TxPowerControlReduction
methods.description: Gets the reduction in transmitter power level due to power control.

methods.name: get_RxPowerLevel
methods.description: Gets the received power level at the interface from the remote device.

methods.name: get_TxBcastRate
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast PHY transmit rate.

methods.name: get_RxBcastPowerLevel
methods.description: Gets the broadcast power level received from the remote device.

methods.name: get_TxPackets
methods.description: Gets the number of packets transmitted to the remote device.

methods.name: get_RxPackets
methods.description: Gets the number of packets received from the remote device.

methods.name: get_RxErroredAndMissedPackets
methods.description: Gets the count of errored and missed packets from the remote device.

methods.name: get_QAM256Capable
methods.description: Checks if the remote device supports 256 QAM.

methods.name: get_PacketAggregationCapability
methods.description: Retrieves the packet aggregation capability supported by the remote device.

methods.name: get_RxSNR
methods.description: Gets the signal-to-noise ratio in dBm.

methods.name: get_Active
methods.description: Checks if the remote device is currently active in the network.
